# Darshan Dye-Chem

> Darshan Dye-Chem is a manufacturer and exporter of acid dyes, direct dyes and specialty colourants based in Vatva GIDC, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. It supplies wholesale and bulk buyers in textile, leather and paper industries across India and overseas. Its shade cards show 139 dye shades with C.I. names and fastness ratings.

## Key facts

- Business type: manufacturer; also wholesale and retail. Proprietorship led by Girish Patel.
- Address: I/149A, Vinoba Bhave Nagar, Dibiyapur, Phase 2, Vatva GIDC, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382445, India
- Girish Patel: +91 93270 94416, darshandyechem@gmail.com
- Archit Patel: +91 95740 68089, patelarchit2572000@gmail.com
- WhatsApp: +919327094416
- GST number: 24ALMPP2816Q1ZI
- IndiaMART profile: https://www.indiamart.com/darshan-dye-chem/

## Pages

- [Home](https://darshandyechem.com/): Ahmedabad manufacturer and exporter of acid dyes, direct dyes and specialty colourants. Browse 139 shades with fastness ratings and request a quote.
- [About Us](https://darshandyechem.com/about/): Darshan Dye-Chem is a proprietor-led dye manufacturer in Vatva GIDC, Ahmedabad. Meet the team, see our laboratory and learn how we supply buyers worldwide.
- [Products](https://darshandyechem.com/products/): Search 139 acid and direct dye shades by name, C.I. number or colour, check fastness ratings and download the shade cards as PDF. Request a sample.
- [Contact Us](https://darshandyechem.com/contact/): Request a quote or sample from Darshan Dye-Chem, Vatva GIDC, Ahmedabad. Call, WhatsApp or email us your dye, shade and quantity requirement.
- [Dye Tools](https://darshandyechem.com/tools/): Free dye calculator for dye quantity, water and cost per batch, plus a dye finder to see if acid or direct dyes suit wool, silk, nylon, leather or cotton.

## Shade cards and data

- [Acid Dyes shade card (PDF, 14 pages)](https://darshandyechem.com/assets/downloads/darshan-acid-dyes-shade-card.pdf): 89 shades on nylon at 0.5% and 2.0% depth, with C.I. names, fastness ratings and an A–Z index.
- [Direct Dyes shade card (PDF, 9 pages)](https://darshandyechem.com/assets/downloads/darshan-direct-dyes-shade-card.pdf): 50 shades on cotton at 0.5% and 2.0% depth, including direct matching shades and an A–Z index.
- [Complete dye list with fastness ratings](https://darshandyechem.com/llms-full.txt): every dye, its C.I. name and light, washing, perspiration and milling ratings in one text file.
